name: mibi-juvenile-S16-a
refs: The adult of this species (project-owned rig render): its body plan, colours and markings. A tall slender lavender creature with no legs: a spindle-shaped body resting on its belly-base, held up on fins, a thin neck and a round head on top, floating just above its shadow.
The species' signed silhouette (project-owned): the adult's outline.
prompt: Paint the JUVENILE of the creature in the references: the same species at a glance, the same colours and markings, but young. Proportions: the head about 45 percent of its height, eyes about 1.3 times larger, limbs, fins and tail about 70 percent of their length, the markings softer. Resting upright on its base with its small fins, floating just above its shadow, three-quarter view from the front left, its head turned to the viewer, cute and calm. Matte painterly rendering like a children's book, light from the top left, a soft flat contact shadow beneath it. One creature, centred, on a plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background with nothing else. No outline glow, no text, no ground, no props, no people.
